lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in roughly equidistant horizontal rows. The most prominent row sits along the mid-lateral line, with larger, more distinct spots appearing posterior to the gill slits and extending towards the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal spot rows, creating a grid-like pattern. The high-luminance blobs are primarily positioned at the vertices where these vertical and horizontal intensity gradients meet.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A clear horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, beginning above the pectoral fin. It exhibits a distinct vertical gradient with highlights on the superior edge and shadow on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs across its visible lateral surface, with a lower density of spots compared to the adjacent lateral flank.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark, elongated silhouette consistent with a remora (Echeneidae) is attached to the ventral region, posterior to the pectoral fin.
